english:
Threadling damage grants a stack of Pack Tactics for 10 seconds. Hits refresh the duration.

Pack Tactics benefits:
• 1 stack: 15% increased Threadling damage
• 2 stacks: 30% increased Threadling damage, and Threadling damage stuns <unstoppable/>Unstoppable Champions

Each Threadling hit at 2 stacks increases Threadling damage by 1.03x until the buff expires.

source.text:
Threadling Damage grants a stack of Pack Tactic for 10 seconds.
Additional Threadling damage refreshes the buff duration.

Pack Tactics x1 | 15% increased Threadling Damage.

Pack Tactics x2 | 30% Increased Threadling Damage.
Threadling Damage stuns Unstoppable Champions.

Each Threadling hit while at x2 stacks will increase Threadling Damage by 1.03x until buff expires.
